note: Work: the Labour Act [Chapter 28:01] (Acts 16/1985 to 11/2023, Veritas's consolidated text of 16 September 2025), section 11(1): no employer may employ a person under sixteen otherwise than as an apprentice, nor an apprentice under thirteen (section 11(1) as amended by Act 5 of 2015); 13 to 15 may do work that is part of school or vocational training (section 11(3)). The Act makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below sixteen (my reading). Majority: the Constitution's copy on Veritas is a scanned PDF with no text, and no copy of the Legal Age of Majority Act was found (ZimLII and Parliament put this client behind Cloudflare); left null. Service: Veritas lists the Defence Act [Chapter 11:02], not read; no conscription law was found; left null. Veritas is a Zimbabwean legal information trust reproducing the Acts as gazetted.

sources.title: Veritas Zimbabwe: Labour Act [Chapter 28:01] (consolidated, 16 September 2025)
sources.said: (b) otherwise than as an apprentice who is under the age of sixteen years.
